Remarks:  
• 
Units and descriptions of the model parameters were lag-phase (λ, days),maximum methane yield (Go, mL/g-
VSadded), and methane production rate (Rmax, mL/g-VSadded /day). 
• 
Initial methane yield data were duplicated. The error band for model parameters lies within 6%.
